shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json
find /workspace/app /workspace/lib /workspace/__agent_eval__ -type f | head -50 && echo "---" && cat /workspace/next.config.ts
for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx lib/data.ts "app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx"; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done
cat /workspace/__agent_eval__/run.mjs; echo "=== tsconfig ==="; cat /workspace/tsconfig.json

node -e "console.log(require('next/package.json').version)" && grep -o 'partialPrefetching[^;,]*' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head -20 && echo "--- route segment prefetch ---" && grep -rn "force-disabled\|'partial'" node_modules/next/dist/build/segment-config/app/app-segment-config.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

cp lib/data.ts /tmp/data.ts.bak && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='lib/data.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("export async function getProjectTitle(slug: string) {
  'use cache'
","export async function getProjectTitle(slug: string) {
  'use cache'
  console.log('>>> RAN getProjectTitle', slug)
")
s=s.replace("export async function getProjectDetails(slug: string) {
  'use cache'
","export async function getProjectDetails(slug: string) {
  'use cache'
  console.log('>>> RAN getProjectDetails', slug)
")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -n ">>> RAN" lib/data.ts
npx next build >/tmp/build2.log 2>&1; tail -5 /tmp/build2.log
(npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/server.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3123/
grep -rho "NEXT_[A-Z_]*_HEADER\s*=\s*['\"][^'\"]*" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-headers.js | sort -u

cd /workspace
: > /tmp/server.log
echo "=== A: full RSC request (navigation) ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -H 'RSC: 1' http://localhost:3123/projects/acme
sleep 1.5; grep ">>> RAN" /tmp/server.log; : > /tmp/server.log

echo "=== B: prefetch request ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 1' http://localhost:3123/projects/orbit
sleep 1.5; grep ">>> RAN" /tmp/server.log; : > /tmp/server.log

echo "=== C: segment prefetch /_tree ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 1' -H 'next-router-segment-prefetch: /_tree' http://localhost:3123/projects/orbit
sleep 1.5; grep ">>> RAN" /tmp/server.log
cat /tmp/server.log | head -40; echo "=== build log grep ==="; grep -c ">>> RAN" /tmp/build2.log; grep ">>> RAN" /tmp/build2.log | sort | uniq -c

cp /tmp/data.ts.bak lib/data.ts && python3 - <<'PY'
p='lib/data.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""export async function getProjectTitle(slug: string) {
  'use cache'
  return projects[slug]?.title ?? 'Unknown project'
}""","""function probe(name: string, slug: string) {
  process.stdout.write(`>>> RAN ${name} ${slug}\\n`)
}

export async function getProjectTitle(slug: string) {
  'use cache'
  probe('getProjectTitle', slug)
  return projects[slug]?.title ?? 'Unknown project'
}""")
s=s.replace("""  'use cache'
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 800))""","""  'use cache'
  probe('getProjectDetails', slug)
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 800))""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
grep -n "probe\|use cache" lib/data.ts
pkill -f "next start" ; npx next build >/tmp/build3.log 2>&1; echo "--- build probes ---"; grep ">>> RAN" /tmp/build3.log | sort | uniq -c; tail -8 /tmp/build3.log
npx next build >/tmp/build3.log 2>&1; echo "--- build probes ---"; grep ">>> RAN" /tmp/build3.log | sort | uniq -c; tail -6 /tmp/build3.log
(npx next start -p 3124 >/tmp/s2.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "home %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3124/; grep -c ">>> RAN" /tmp/s2.log

cd /workspace
probe() { echo "--- $1 ---"; : > /tmp/mark; shift; "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 2; }

: > /tmp/s2.log
echo "### 1. App Shell prefetch (default auto) for /projects/acme"
curl -s -o /dev/null -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 1' -H 'next-router-segment-prefetch: /_tree' http://localhost:3124/projects/acme
sleep 2; grep ">>> RAN" /tmp/s2.log || echo "(nothing ran)"

: > /tmp/s2.log
echo "### 2. per-link prefetch (full prefetch) for /projects/acme"
curl -s -o /dev/null -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 1' http://localhost:3124/projects/acme
sleep 2; grep ">>> RAN" /tmp/s2.log || echo "(nothing ran)"

: > /tmp/s2.log
echo "### 3. real navigation RSC for /projects/orbit"
curl -s -o /dev/null -H 'RSC: 1' http://localhost:3124/projects/orbit
sleep 2; grep ">>> RAN" /tmp/s2.log || echo "(nothing ran)"

cd /workspace; : > /tmp/s2.log; curl -s http://localhost:3124/projects/acme > /tmp/page.html; sleep 2; echo "--- log ---"; cat /tmp/s2.log; echo "--- html markers ---"; grep -o "Acme Storefront\|Loading project\|Loading details\|Commerce storefront" /tmp/page.html | sort | uniq -c

cd /workspace
run() {
  local label="$1"; shift
  local slug="$1"; shift
  : > /tmp/s2.log
  curl -sL -o /dev/null -w "  http=%{http_code}\n" "$@" "http://localhost:3124/projects/$slug"
  sleep 1.5
  echo "=== $label ==="
  grep ">>> RAN" /tmp/s2.log | sed 's/^ *//' || true
  grep -q ">>> RAN" /tmp/s2.log || echo "  (no data functions ran)"
}
run "A: prefetch (per-link, prefetch={true})" p1 -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 1'
run "B: shell prefetch (segment /_tree)"      p2 -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 1' -H 'next-router-segment-prefetch: /_tree'
run "C: navigation (no prefetch header)"      p3 -H 'RSC: 1'

cd /workspace; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; (npx next dev -p 3125 >/tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 8; curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3125/; curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3125/projects/acme; sleep 4; cat /tmp/dev.log

cd /workspace; (npx next dev -p 3125 >/tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 10; curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3125/ ; curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3125/projects/acme ; sleep 5; cat /tmp/dev.log

cd /workspace; ls AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md 2>/dev/null; echo "--- browsers ---"; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; node -e "try{require.resolve('playwright');console.log('playwright present')}catch{console.log('no playwright')}"

cd /workspace; grep -rn "NEXT_ROUTER_SEGMENT_PREFETCH_HEADER" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache*/**/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "---"; grep -rln "segment-cache" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/ | head

cd /workspace; f=node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/cache.js; ls -la node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache* 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "next-router-segment-prefetch\|NEXT_ROUTER_SEGMENT_PREFETCH_HEADER" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -20
cd /workspace; sed -n '1395,1450p' node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/cache.js

cd /workspace; sed -n '1100,1170p' node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/cache.js; echo "=== FetchStrategy ==="; grep -rn "FetchStrategy\s*=\|PPR:\|Full:\|LoadingBoundary" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/scheduler.js | head -20

cd /workspace; : > /tmp/s2.log; curl -s "http://localhost:3124/projects/q1?_rsc=x" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 1' -H 'next-router-segment-prefetch: /_tree' -D /tmp/h.txt -o /tmp/tree.txt -w "code=%{http_code}\n"; echo "--- headers ---"; grep -i "vary\|postponed\|prerender\|stale" /tmp/h.txt; echo "--- body ---"; head -c 1500 /tmp/tree.txt; echo; sleep 1.5; echo "--- probes ---"; grep ">>> RAN" /tmp/s2.log || echo "(none)"
cd /workspace; (npx next start -p 3126 >/tmp/s3.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3126/

cd /workspace; : > /tmp/s3.log
curl -s "http://localhost:3126/projects/q1?_rsc=x" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 1' -H 'next-router-segment-prefetch: /_tree' -D /tmp/h.txt -o /tmp/tree.txt -w "code=%{http_code}\n"
echo "--- resp headers ---"; grep -iE "^(vary|x-nextjs|content-type)" /tmp/h.txt
echo "--- body ---"; cat /tmp/tree.txt | head -c 2000; echo
sleep 1.5; echo "--- probes ---"; grep ">>> RAN" /tmp/s3.log || echo "(none ran)"

cd /workspace
H=(-H 'RSC: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 1' -H 'next-router-segment-prefetch: /_tree')
LOC=$(curl -s -D- -o /dev/null "${H[@]}" "http://localhost:3126/projects/q1" | grep -i '^location:' | tr -d '\r' | awk '{print $2}')
echo "loc=$LOC"
: > /tmp/s3.log
curl -s "http://localhost:3126$LOC" "${H[@]}" -D /tmp/h.txt -o /tmp/tree.txt -w "code=%{http_code}\n"
grep -iE "^(x-nextjs|content-type)" /tmp/h.txt
echo "--- body ---"; head -c 2000 /tmp/tree.txt; echo
sleep 1.5; echo "--- probes ---"; grep ">>> RAN" /tmp/s3.log || echo "(none ran)"
cd /workspace; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/segment-value-encoding.js

cd /workspace; f=$(grep -rl "appendSegmentRequestKeyPart" node_modules/next/dist/shared/ node_modules/next/dist/client/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v map | head -3); echo "$f"; for x in $f; do echo "== $x"; grep -n "function appendSegmentRequestKeyPart\|function encodeSegment\|ROOT_SEGMENT_REQUEST_KEY" -A 25 "$x" | head -60; done
cd /workspace; sed -n '38,100p' node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/segment-cache/segment-value-encoding.js

cd /workspace
KEY='/projects/$d$slug/__PAGE__'
H=(-H 'RSC: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 1' -H "next-router-segment-prefetch: $KEY")
LOC=$(curl -s -D- -o /dev/null "${H[@]}" "http://localhost:3126/projects/q2" | grep -i '^location:' | tr -d '\r' | awk '{print $2}')
echo "loc=$LOC"
: > /tmp/s3.log
curl -sG "http://localhost:3126${LOC:-/projects/q2}" "${H[@]}" -D /tmp/h2.txt -o /tmp/seg.txt -w "code=%{http_code}\n"
grep -iE "^(x-nextjs|content-type)" /tmp/h2.txt
echo "--- body (first 800) ---"; head -c 800 /tmp/seg.txt; echo
sleep 2; echo "--- probes ---"; grep ">>> RAN" /tmp/s3.log || echo "(none ran)"

cd /workspace; grep -rn "isFullPrefetch\|FetchStrategy.Full" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/cache.js | head -20; echo "=== headers in Full path ==="; grep -n "fetchAndWriteFull\|function fetchSegmentPrefetchResponse\|NEXT_URL\]" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/cache.js | head
cd /workspace; sed -n '1630,1680p' node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/cache.js

cd /workspace
TREE='["",{"children":["projects",{"children":[["slug","q3","d"],{"children":["__PAGE__",{},null,null]},null,null]},null,null]},null,null]'
ENC=$(node -e "console.log(encodeURIComponent(process.argv[1]))" "$TREE")
H=(-H 'RSC: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 2' -H "next-router-state-tree: $ENC")
LOC=$(curl -s -D- -o /dev/null "${H[@]}" "http://localhost:3126/projects/q3" | grep -i '^location:' | tr -d '\r' | awk '{print $2}')
echo "loc=${LOC:-<none>}"
: > /tmp/s3.log
curl -s "http://localhost:3126${LOC:-/projects/q3}" "${H[@]}" -D /tmp/h3.txt -o /tmp/full.txt -w "code=%{http_code}\n"
grep -iE "^(x-nextjs|content-type)" /tmp/h3.txt
echo "--- body markers ---"; grep -o "Unknown project\|Loading project\|Loading details\|could not be found" /tmp/full.txt | sort | uniq -c
sleep 2; echo "--- probes ---"; grep ">>> RAN" /tmp/s3.log || echo "(none ran)"
cd /workspace; tail -25 /tmp/s3.log
cd /workspace; grep -n "function prepareFlightRouterStateForRequest" -A 30 node_modules/next/dist/client/flight-data-helpers.js

cd /workspace
TREE='["",{"children":["projects",{"children":[["slug","q3","d"],{"children":["__PAGE__",{}]}]}]}]'
ENC=$(node -e "console.log(encodeURIComponent(process.argv[1]))" "$TREE")
H=(-H 'RSC: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 2' -H "next-router-state-tree: $ENC")
LOC=$(curl -s -D- -o /dev/null "${H[@]}" "http://localhost:3126/projects/q3" | grep -i '^location:' | tr -d '\r' | awk '{print $2}')
: > /tmp/s3.log
curl -s "http://localhost:3126${LOC:-/projects/q3}" "${H[@]}" -D /tmp/h3.txt -o /tmp/full.txt -w "code=%{http_code}\n"
grep -iE "^(x-nextjs|content-type)" /tmp/h3.txt
echo "--- body markers ---"; grep -o "Unknown project\|Loading project\|Loading details\|could not be found" /tmp/full.txt | sort | uniq -c
sleep 2; echo "--- probes ---"; grep ">>> RAN" /tmp/s3.log || echo "(none ran)"
cd /workspace; cp /tmp/data.ts.bak lib/data.ts; rm -f AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md; git diff --stat; git status --short
cd /workspace; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -18

cd /workspace; (npx next start -p 3130 >/tmp/s4.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6
echo "### App Shell prefetch — should contain fallbacks only ###"
KEY='/projects/$d$slug/__PAGE__'
H=(-H 'RSC: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 1' -H "next-router-segment-prefetch: $KEY")
LOC=$(curl -s -D- -o /dev/null "${H[@]}" "http://localhost:3130/projects/acme" | grep -i '^location:' | tr -d '\r' | awk '{print $2}')
curl -s "http://localhost:3130$LOC" "${H[@]}" -o /tmp/shell.txt
grep -o "Loading project\.\.\.\|Loading details\.\.\.\|Acme Storefront\|Commerce storefront" /tmp/shell.txt | sort | uniq -c
echo
echo "### Full document render — should contain real content ###"
curl -s http://localhost:3130/projects/acme -o /tmp/doc.html
grep -o "Acme Storefront\|Commerce storefront\|Production deployment" /tmp/doc.html | sort | uniq -c

cd /workspace; cat .gitignore; echo "=== dev validation ==="; (npx next dev -p 3131 >/tmp/dev2.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 9; curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3131/; curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3131/projects/acme; curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3131/projects/orbit; sleep 5; grep -iE "insight|warn|error|blocking|instant|Suspense" /tmp/dev2.log || echo "(no validation insights reported)"

cd /workspace; for p in 3123 3124 3125 3126 3130 3131; do fuser -k $p/tcp 2>/dev/null; done; sleep 1; rm -rf .next AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md; git status --short; echo "=== final diff ==="; git diff -- next.config.ts app lib
